Welcome back to Agent School — lesson two.
Yesterday we learned AI predicts the next word.
Today: how it learned to predict so well.
A programmer wrote: if this, then that.
Every answer, typed by a human.
You show examples… and the machine finds the rules itself.
Hide the next word in a sentence.
A little math nudges it… to be less wrong next time.
Those nudges tweak billions of tiny numbers called parameters.
That's why even its creators can't point to the line of code that writes an answer.
Tomorrow… why AI can't even see the word "strawberry."
